correctness.rationale: The grounded Laplacian B=L_(M,M) is positive definite for connected G and h_r=0,h_M=c^-1 B^-1 omega_M satisfies cLh=omega-Omega e_r. Translating Y=theta-h yields universal drift Omega e_r and the same reset map, proving the whole stationary-law affine identity. Synchronous coupling contracts in mean square under positive 2cL+lambda e_re_r^T, establishing unique finite-second-moment stationary law. The stationary generator gives mean h+Omega/lambda 1 and c(LC+CL)+lambda(C-JCJ)=Omega² e_re_r^T/lambda. Its matrix operator is the killing resolvent for two independent graph walks with strictly positive Green entries from (r,r). Block equations imply C_rr=Omega²/lambda²+O(lambda^-3), C_rM=cOmega² a^T/lambda³+O(lambda^-4), C_MM=2cOmega²/lambda³ int_0^inf e^-Bt aa^T e^-Bt dt+O(lambda^-4). All entries of the coefficient are positive because each grounded component meets a reset neighbor. Independent graph-by-graph linear solves and scalar two-vertex identity passed.
residual_risks: For Omega=0 the centered law is a point mass, so strict covariance positivity requires Omega!=0.
The exact model is unwrapped and linear; no claim on nonlinear circle-valued Kuramoto stationary laws or a graph-size-uniform expansion.
